# Recap: our call on 9 October 2026

## Today
Every evening you copy each order from your Square Online store into the production sheet the bakers read at four in the morning. That is about 25 orders a day and closer to 40 on Fridays, and a missed order means a customer arrives to no bread, which happened twice last month.

## What needs to change
Every online order lands in the bakers' sheet on its own, so you can go home at six, and it is working before the holiday rush in mid-November.

## Next step
I recommend a defined piece of work: connecting your Square store to the production sheet. It is one clear job between two tools, your product list is already clean, and the approach is straightforward. If you say yes, I'll send a short written scope with a fixed quote, and work starts when you sign it.

## What I need from you
- A recent export of your Square orders, so the scope matches what the store actually sends.

Robin
